content: Power in-game analytics and player insights with instant responsiveness, enabling real-time segmentation and A/B testing based on in-game behavior to optimize player engagement.
Optimize monetization and drive ad decisions with real-time event data, dynamically adjusting player cohorts based on user behavior to enable personalized offers and custom in-game experiences.
Game Performance Monitoring (GPM) - track game performance, logs, and telemetry in real time with crash analytics and performance tracking.
Effortlessly handle the high-cardinality, high-concurrency workloads needed to power real-time leaderboards, live game state tracking, telemetry processing, and dynamic player segmentation.
Store every user interaction with 100% event fidelity, thanks to at least 10x compression while reducing infrastructure costs and enabling deep historical analysis.
